# South Florida Windows & Doors

## About
South Florida Windows & Doors (SFWD) is a licensed and insured hurricane impact window and door company serving South Florida for 30+ years. We supply and install hurricane-rated impact windows and doors for residential and commercial properties.

## What We Do
- Supply and installation of hurricane impact windows
- Supply and installation of hurricane impact doors
- Sliding glass door installation
- Commercial window and door installation
- Replacement windows and doors
- Free in-home estimates

## Products
- Hurricane impact windows (single-hung, double-hung, casement, bay & bow, awning, picture)
- Hurricane impact doors (entry doors, French doors, sliding glass doors)
- NOA (Notice of Acceptance) approved products
- Florida Building Code compliant

## Service Areas
Broward County and Palm Beach County, Florida — including Fort Lauderdale, Pompano Beach, Boca Raton, Coral Springs, Deerfield Beach, Delray Beach, Pembroke Pines, Hollywood, Davie, Plantation, Weston, Boynton Beach, West Palm Beach
